requirements.label: 120 Total Credits
requirements.hint: The BFA in Jazz and Contemplative Studies requires a minimum of 120 credits. Requirements follow the 2024-2025 Silent Advisor; SMTD students follow the curriculum of their admit year.

requirements.label: Non-Music credits (30)
requirements.hint: At least 30 credits outside music. Courses within Arts Administration, Dance, and Theatre also count as non-Music.

requirements.label: Music Theory and Musicology core
requirements.hint: THEORY 149 Written Skills I, JAZZ 114 Contemporary Basic Musicianship, PAT 150 Experiential Music Theory, and MUSICOL 139 Intro to the Study of Music.

requirements.label: Additional Musicology or Theory courses (3)
requirements.hint: Three additional courses chosen from Musicology and/or Theory. Other SMTD electives may substitute in consultation with an advisor.

requirements.label: ENS 460: Jazz Ensemble (4 terms)
requirements.hint: Four terms of ENS 460 Jazz Ensemble. The planner counts one election; repeat it across terms.

requirements.label: Additional ensemble (4 terms)
requirements.hint: Four additional terms chosen from ENS 462 Small Jazz Ensemble or ENS 467 Creative Arts Orchestra. Repeat elections across terms count.

requirements.label: Performance lessons (24 credits)
requirements.hint: Private jazz study every term, minimum 24 credits or completion of JAZZ 402.

requirements.label: MUSPERF 440: Senior Recital
requirements.hint: Zero credit capstone recital in the final year.

requirements.label: Jazz core requirements
requirements.hint: JAZZ 113 Jazz Piano, 422 Jazz Styles and Historical Practice, 423 Black Music Matters, 432 Fundamentals of Rhythm, 470 Improvisational Forms, 466 Improvisation I, 467 Improvisation II, 471 Upper Level Improvisation, and 468 Compositional Forms. JAZZ 432 is not yet in the planner catalog, so the audit counts 8 of the 9; verify JAZZ 432 by hand.

requirements.label: Contemplative practices (4 terms)
requirements.hint: JAZZ 450 Contemplative Practices Seminar or JAZZ 455 Creativity and Consciousness, elected four terms. The planner counts one election; repeat across terms.

requirements.label: First year writing
requirements.hint: ENGLISH 124, 125, or an equivalent first year writing course.

requirements.label: Upper level writing
requirements.hint: An upper level writing course approved by the Sweetland Writing Center.

requirements.label: Non-SMTD subject courses (5)
requirements.hint: Minimum 5 non-SMTD courses chosen from Anthropology, Cultural Studies, Psychology, Religion, Neuroscience, and other areas as approved with a departmental faculty advisor. We are still building automatic checking for this advisor approved list.
